title: The Wars of Adam
segments: Father, I have sinned. I have broken thy
knowledge of evil. I have lost my power.
My children rebel against me. My
heavenly sons are cut off from me.
Forgive me. To my son. I will forgive
thee. But thou must prove thyself in the
earth. I shall send thy heavenly
children to aid thee. I give thee power.
let us fulfill the will of the father.
